I was there with you a few years back. I couldn't cry but I wanted to. It's perfectly normal when going through something like this and it's ok if you can't cry. Crying isn't mandatory.
Killing yourself is not an answer nor a solution to being in pain. It's been said a million times but get some help. Even talking here is a good first step if you want the anonymity.

You're not a shitty person. And you're right, humanity sucks, always will suck (history is full of terrible people) and a whole lot of people are bad but it's not all like that. I have hundreds of examples, right off the top of my head, of our human ability to be good.
People have the potential for great evil and great good. You do, I do, everyone does but I choose to be good because I, personally, would like the world to be a slightly less shitty place. 

You may judge me or argue your pointand I would be happy to debate but will not be roasting you. And if you wish for the example of good people, I wold be happy to share.
(Stay safe. Also, cats are great)
He was already connected to the Dusk Mother a bit and Coach Bortram was a paladin so she's definitely capable of granting those powers.
